summary.cer_reference: inferred physical PDF flow; not semantic ground truth

rule_text_collisions.basis: Heuristic: horizontal vector rules at least 40 pt wide and at most 2 pt high cross the central 20–90% of a native text line box. New page/rule/text combinations require review; intentional strikethroughs and glyph bounds are not resolved.

visual_document_ssim.basis: global visual mean; separate from text and structure

visual_every_page_ssim.basis: worst page; the mean cannot hide a bad page

text_cer.basis: inferred physical PDF flow; not semantic ground truth

text_missing_characters.basis: normalized character count deficits; sequence errors remain separate

text_added_characters.basis: normalized character count surplus; native-only references cannot grade added OCR text

numeric_date_changes.basis: critical values checked independently of aggregate CER

geometry_median_mm.basis: matched same-page word box origins; coverage and baseline errors are also reported

geometry_p95_mm.basis: matched same-page word box origins; unmatched content is not silently accepted

editable_text.basis: visible ordinary Word text; protection, hidden text and dominant textboxes checked

no_unverified_tables.basis: source model or inferred native table evidence; ambiguity requires review

no_unverified_textboxes.basis: independent floating text exceptions need source evidence and review; boxes are not certified automatically

native_images_preserved.basis: unmatched native images, excluding justified scan backgrounds; unresolved OCR replacements require review

edit_probe_content_preserved.basis: save/reopen/render of a copy; exact XML insertion, expected added text, objects and original file must be preserved

edit_probe_pagination.basis: explicit diagnostic budget for a three-word insertion; natural downstream reflow is also reported

edit_probe_no_new_rule_collisions.basis: new intersections of thin horizontal vector rules with central text-line boxes require review; heuristic, not glyph-level proof

cv.visual_findings: Page 1: two stationary decorative rules cross the moved headings after the three-word edit. Page 2 unchanged. Photo/table/text retained. This is a detected residual conversion limitation.

image_matching_caveat: missing_native_images counts unmatched source rasters, not proven deletion. PLOS has 11 source and 11 target images; page migration plus resized pixels leaves 10 unverified.

web_cer_without_ground_truth.basis: native PDF text omits OCR regions; a complete external reference is required

rule_text_collisions.basis: Heuristic: horizontal vector rules at least 40 pt wide and at most 2 pt high cross the central 20–90% of a native text line box. New page/rule/text combinations require review; intentional strikethroughs and glyph bounds are not resolved.

web.ui_verification: HTML checkbox and HTTP upload/poll/download; no native browser interaction verified

limits: Physical reading order, paragraphs, columns and repeated edge roles are inferred.
One edit operation via LibreOffice; Microsoft Word not used as renderer.
Previously used corpus; not a fresh blind holdout.
Complex public PDFs, rotation and anchored decorations still have conversion errors.
